description: Regenerate an expired live so it can be broadcast again. Only works when status is expired (otherwise 400 with the current status). Keeps the same stream key, but the RTMP server may change: update it in OBS. Start broadcasting within 15 minutes or the live expires again. Returns {id, status: provisioning, stream_key, stream_key_id, rtmp, region, started_at}. stream_key is a secret credential: show it only when the user asks for it (e.g. to set up OBS).
name: panda_regenerate_live
title: Regenerate Live
